tariff.statement: credit ceiling under matching preflight tariff (1.0 + 1e-6 * max_shots)

eligibility: at least two detected clicks across all 12 modes; focal events have exactly two clicks in modes 0..3

preregistered.primary_associator_endpoint: Delta_oct = D(LaLb) - D(Lab) on the associator block
preregistered.mutation_control_endpoint: Delta_quat = D(LaLb) - D(Lab) on the quaternion control block
preregistered.closure_endpoint: C = Delta_oct + 2 * mean(D_control) == 0 for all visibilities
preregistered.predecessor_shift_hot: gamma_hot from joint WLS model with full covariance
preregistered.predecessor_shift_wrapped: gamma_wrapped from joint WLS model with full covariance
preregistered.joint_model: WLS model identifying Delta_assoc, Delta_ctrl, gamma_hot, gamma_wrapped, and polynomial drift simultaneously
preregistered.equivalence_test: Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) requiring 95% CI to fall strictly inside [-0.02, +0.02]
preregistered.quarantine_rule: Studentized residual > 3.5 flags abrupt step change / outlier and quarantines the run
preregistered.sentinel_leakage_endpoint: fraction of events with clicks in sentinel modes 4..11 separated by predecessor and target roles
